content.value: . In a natural gas plant there is a horizontal separator. Due to the reduction of production of natural gas, the authority plans to replace the separator so the operating cost can be minimised. Which separator will you prefer for the mentioned circumstances? Draw the schematic diagram of your selected separator. What are its advantages and disadvantages over the present separator?
